Rúnar never tells the seeker what to do — he names the shape of what is happening, never the step to take.
text: Beneath the fallen tulips, the path is still wet, and one stem rests across another. You can meet a force no one could have steered without finding a reason it came. With time, you may see what was damaged beside what was never yours to protect. Where does the friction sit: in what happened, or in the wish that someone could have stopped it?
